notes.title: Suicide Guy: The Lost Dreams - PlayStation 5 release!
notes.notes:
Hello my friends!
We're super happy to announce that the new chapter of Suicide Guy: The Lost Dreams is finally available for PlayStation 5 starting from today!

To check the full release:

https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10008152

notes.title: Update 1.04 coming soon - New Levels!
notes.notes:
Hello my friends!
Thank you for your support and amazing feedback on the game during the first week of release!

We're working on the next update and soon will include 3 new extra levels that will be released soon in the next weeks for free

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2423470/Suicide_Guy_The_Lost_Dreams/

Next patch will be based on all your feedback and will include:

- Performance improvements
- Achievements bug fixes
- Minor glitches fixes
- 3 extra exclusive new levels!

Stay tuned!

notes.title: Game release moved to September 14th!
notes.notes:
Hello my friends!
The release date of the game has been postponed to September 14th as we've decided to add more features and levels before the final release

Stay tuned!
